tool.name: Biomni: Analyze Barcode Sequencing Data
tool.description: Analyze sequencing data to extract, quantify and determine lineage relationships of barcodes.
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/analyze_barcode_sequencing_data_wrapper.py' --output '$output' --input_file '$input_file' #if $barcode_pattern --barcode_pattern '$barcode_pattern' #end if #if $flanking_seq_5prime --flanking_seq_5prime '$flanking_seq_5prime' #end if #if $flanking_seq_3prime --flanking_seq_3prime '$flanking_seq_3prime' #end if #if $min_count --min_count '$min_count' #end if #if $output_dir --output_dir '$output_dir' #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input File
param.help: Path to the input sequencing file in FASTQ or FASTA format

param.name: barcode_pattern
param.label: Barcode Pattern
param.help: Regular expression pattern to identify barcodes. If None, will use flanking sequences

param.name: flanking_seq_5prime
param.label: Flanking Seq 5Prime
param.help: 5' flanking sequence of the barcode region

param.name: flanking_seq_3prime
param.label: Flanking Seq 3Prime
param.help: 3' flanking sequence of the barcode region

param.name: min_count
param.label: Min Count
param.help: Minimum count threshold for considering a barcode

tool.help:
**Biomni: Analyze Barcode Sequencing Data**
Analyze sequencing data to extract, quantify and determine lineage relationships of barcodes.
Parameters ---------- input_file : str Path to the input sequencing file in FASTQ or FASTA format barcode_pattern : str, optional Regular expression pattern to identify barcodes. If None, will use flanking sequences flanking_seq_5prime : str, optional 5' flanking sequence of the barcode region flanking_seq_3prime : str, optional 3' flanking sequence of the barcode region min_count : int, default=5 Minimum count threshold for considering a barcode output_dir : str, default="./results" Directory to save output files
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the analysis steps and results
**Domain**: synthetic_biology **Function**: analyze_barcode_sequencing_data
